name: Delicious Fireside Merriment
desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The thick raw cuts carry hints of pine and salt, the sausages give off a deep smoky fragrance, and the ham slices add a rich, savory touch. Bold and hearty, it's a feast any Nod-Krai local would give a thumbs-up to.

value.text: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
